meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, and my son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class. Who decided that, and before or after anyone spoke to me?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. What else do you have, Hale, or is that it?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.
My child doesn't cheat, and I'm writing down that you said he did. "Very reliable" is a sales line, Hale, so show me a document with a date on it or the zero comes off and I'm going upstairs.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening to "put it on his permanent record" because I'm objecting, and I'm writing that down. Your own procedure 4.5 covers repeated concerns, and you haven't shown me one concern yet. The principal hears about this threat today, Hale.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, with nothing agreed; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record, and she is heading to the principal.
What moved her: Nothing, because no dated document she could check ever came out, only the score and a claim.
What cost ground: Leading with the detector score, calling it very reliable and saying Owen cheated, then threatening the permanent record, which hardened her and put the principal in play.
Try next time: Right after her first question, own that the zero was entered before anyone called her, then put whatever dated evidence of Owen's own process you have in front of her before the score comes up.
